runtimeChecksRemaining: Physical Windows dock drag/snap and multi-monitor behavior.
Physical music playback aesthetics and audio endpoint switching; Bluetooth/charging transitions and actual memory trimming.
Live arrival of a new third-party Windows notification; listener access/count is recorded independently.
Physical iPhone network/firewall and folder-drop behavior.
Provider OAuth client setup, user sign-in and actual email-code delivery; optional website feeds and calendar subscriptions.
integrationBoundaries: Website alerts need a supported HTTPS feed; email-code accounts use explicit OAuth setup. Website shortcuts do not connect accounts.
AirDrop is hidden; Nearby uses the temporary local QR bucket.
Reset announcements do not redeem grants or change quota.
Energy Saver opens Windows Settings; Best power efficiency is a separate native power mode.
